items.title: Trane Technologies (TT) Sees HVAC Backlog Jump As It Raises Revenue Guidance
items.summary: Trane Technologies (NYSE:TT) reports a significant surge in commercial HVAC demand, driving a substantial increase in its order backlog. Management indicates the company faces no capacity constraints and has expanded production capacity several times to support this demand. The company has raised its revenue guidance for the current year, citing strong momentum across its core commercial HVAC operations.
